title: IP Litigation Involving Willful Infringement or Enhanced Damages
answer:
The "enhanced damages" mention in 1038-00006 is only in the mediation statement, not in the verified complaint. The verified complaint seeks "compensatory and exemplary damages" but doesn't specifically plead enhanced damages for willful misappropriation in the complaint itself.

So 1038-00006 does not qualify because the firm did not seek enhanced damages in the pleadings (the verified complaint).

Now let me also reconsider the trade secret matters (1008-00005 and 1010-00005). These are trade secret matters where the firm was the plaintiff, but the enhanced damages were discussed in strategy memos and demand letters, not in the pleadings themselves. Also, these are trade secret matters, not "willful infringement" matters.

Let me also reconsider whether I should include the trade secret matters at all. The user asked for "IP litigation matters where we alleged willful infringement or sought enhanced damages." 

The user is drafting a complaint that will plead enhanced damages. The user wants precedent. The user's use of "willful infringement" is a term of art in patent/trademark/copyright law. Trade secret misappropriation uses "willful and malicious misappropriation" instead.
